title: Budgets
pastPeriod: This period has ended: you can review it, and limits can still be edited.

total.title: Total budget
total.noneHint: Set one number for the whole period to see what you can still spend today.

row.carryHint: When on, money you did not spend this period is added to the next one
row.limitInvalid: The limit must be more than 0.

list.title: By category
list.emptyHint: Set a limit for Food, Transport and so on to get a heads-up before you hit it.

empty.title: No budgets this period
empty.hint: Start fast with a ready-made template, or set a limit for each category yourself. You can always change it.
empty.pastHint: This period has ended and had no budgets. Pick a more recent month in the month switcher.

error.title: Could not load budgets
error.hint: The connection may be unstable. Please try again.

add.title: Add a budget
add.desc: Each category has one limit per period. A category limit also counts its sub-categories.
add.allUsed: You already have a budget for every spending category.

delete.title: Delete this budget?
delete.body: Only this period's limit is removed. Your transactions stay untouched.
delete.name: Budget: {{name}}

template.title: Choose a budget template
template.desc: Enter your monthly income and we split limits across categories. You preview before anything is applied.

kindHint.50_30_20: 50% needs, 30% wants, 20% savings. A good start for beginners.
kindHint.6_JARS: 55% necessities, 10% education, 10% long-term savings, 10% play, 10% financial freedom, 5% giving.
kindHint.CUSTOM: Set your own percentages per group. They must total exactly 100%.

template.incomeHint: Only used to work out the split. It does not create a transaction.

custom.noCategories: A group without categories counts as savings: we set the money aside, no budget is created.

preview.title: You will get
preview.approx: Category amounts here are an even-split estimate. When applied, we split by your last 3 periods of spending, so numbers can differ slightly.
preview.empty: This template has no categories to budget.
preview.planCut: The Free plan allows {{max}} budgets (the total counts). If you go over, we keep the total and the biggest categories.
preview.reservedHint: No budget is created for this part

overwrite.legend: If a category already has a budget
overwrite.keepHint: Only adds budgets for categories without one. Limits you set stay as they are. (Recommended)
overwrite.replaceHint: Existing limits of the categories in this template are replaced by the new amounts.

rollover.title: Carry leftovers into this period
rollover.intro: We take what you did not spend last period and add it to this period's limit, for budgets that have carry-over turned on.
rollover.rule1: Overspending carries 0: we never subtract it from the next period.
rollover.rule2: Money already carried is never carried twice, so running this again is safe.
rollover.rule3: Base limits you edited by hand are kept.
rollover.noneCarried: Nothing was carried. Turn on “Carry leftovers to next period” on last period's budgets first.

detail.title: Spending by category
detail.noBudget: This category has no budget in this period.
detail.empty: No spending in this period yet
detail.emptyHint: When you log spending in this category it will show up here.
detail.notFound: We could not find this category.
